tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List project categories
tools.description: List the portfolio's project categories with their labels and project counts.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the published portfolio projects of Michael Chandler / MC Design Build, optionally filtered by category. Returns id, title, location, specs and roles.

category.description: Optional category filter. One of: owners-representation, residential-construction, design-build, hospitality, civil, development, commercial, estate-management

search.description: Optional free-text match on title, subtitle or location.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project details
tools.description: Get the full published details of one portfolio project by id, including its narrative description and photo gallery paths.

id.description: Project id, e.g. 'miami-beach' (use list_projects to discover ids).
